rule: A run MUST select exactly one method_id before fitting. Method switching requires a new run_id and a written reason; no silent fallback.

SHQ_BEST_CORE_V1_1.purpose: Single humanoid identity replacement where face/torso are reliable but hands/legs may articulate differently.
SHQ_BEST_CORE_V1_1.fit_rule: Estimate a,R from trusted Face+Torso anchors. Use the ground/sole anchor to solve final translation t and horizontal contact.
SHQ_BEST_CORE_V1_1.paste_rule: scene_scale=1/a; donor_scale=1.0; integer donor paste; Virtual Master.
do_not: Do not let low-confidence hand/leg points pull a.
Do not call placement a pose pass.

DDXX_WHOLEBODY_SIMILARITY_V1.purpose: Whole-body similarity fit when all paired landmarks are semantically corresponding, visible and trusted.
DDXX_WHOLEBODY_SIMILARITY_V1.fit_rule: Weighted Umeyama similarity with optional Huber IRLS: q = a * (p @ R) + t.
DDXX_WHOLEBODY_SIMILARITY_V1.inverse_rule: Apply inverse transform to scene: A_scene = inverse(R)/a; donor remains native and is pasted at the derived integer offset.
DDXX_WHOLEBODY_SIMILARITY_V1.anchor_rule: Each landmark records semantic_name, source_image_sha, coordinate_frame, crop_offset, confidence, occlusion and annotation_method.
DDXX_WHOLEBODY_SIMILARITY_V1.fixture_limit: The recorded 11-point result came from a manually annotated, flattened contact-sheet panel. It is a solver regression fixture only, not a production-image quality threshold and not evidence that every new image has 7.5px residual.

DDXX_MECHA_CORE_SIMILARITY_V1.purpose: One-mecha SOLO fit. Reuses the DDXX similarity mathematics but uses machine-specific semantic anchors.
DDXX_MECHA_CORE_SIMILARITY_V1.annotation_rule: Manual or a mecha-specific semantic keypoint annotator. Arbitrary contour samples, rubble pixels and background-connected silhouette points are NOT joint landmarks.
DDXX_MECHA_CORE_SIMILARITY_V1.pose_rule: The donor must preserve target articulation, facing, camera perspective and object axes. A global similarity cannot repair a different arm/leg pose.
DDXX_MECHA_CORE_SIMILARITY_V1.paste_rule: Only after anchor audit, fit gate, pose gate and native-size/aspect gate pass.

SHQ_MULTI_RETURN_V1.purpose: Compose N independently validated SOLO donors onto one common scene.
SHQ_MULTI_RETURN_V1.phase_a: For each unit i, treat only target i as the subject; all other units remain scenery/context. Produce one independent target record, donor, fit and pose report.
SHQ_MULTI_RETURN_V1.phase_b: Remove all original target units from a common EMPTY scene, transform the scene once, then paste the N accepted donors in audited far-to-near z-order.
SHQ_MULTI_RETURN_V1.scale_rule: A common S_star is permitted only with explicit ratio_i = S_star/S_i. If ratio_i deviates beyond the declared tolerance, label MULTI_SCALE_COMPROMISE; never claim exact per-unit slot fit.
SHQ_MULTI_RETURN_V1.full_exact_rule: For all units to have exact slot ratio 1.0 in one global scene, their S_i must agree within tolerance, or all donors must be generated at the common S_star native dimensions before paste.
